mapper.sql: FROM tb_take_orders tk JOIN tb_orders o ON o.id=tk.order_id AND o.deleted=0 JOIN tb_user u ON u.id=o.user_id JOIN tb_category c ON c.id=o.category_id JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.role='PICKUP' AND p.school_id=#{schoolId} JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot r ON r.order_id=o.id AND r.role='RECEIVE' AND r.school_id=#{schoolId} WHERE tk.user_id=#{userId} AND tk.deleted=0 AND tk.status=2 AND o.status=5 AND o.price IS NOT NULL AND o.price != 0

FROM tb_orders o JOIN tb_category c ON c.id=o.category_id JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot p ON p.order_id=o.id AND p.role='PICKUP' JOIN tb_order_address_snapshot r ON r.order_id=o.id AND r.role='RECEIVE' WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.deleted=0 AND o.status=-1 AND o.create_time > #{unpaidAfter}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) ) AS runner_receivable_count, (SELECT MIN(o.id) ) AS runner_receivable_order_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) ) AS runner_unpaid_count, (SELECT MIN(o.id) ) AS runner_unpaid_order_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_second_hand_order WHERE buyer_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status IN (0,2)) AS second_hand_buyer_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_second_hand_order WHERE buyer_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status=2) AS second_hand_buyer_notice_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_second_hand_order WHERE seller_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND (status=1 OR (status=8 AND transfer_state='WAIT_USER_CONFIRM'))) AS second_hand_seller_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_second_hand_bargain WHERE seller_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status=0) AS bargain_pending_count
